summary: Phase 1 security audit: all checks pass. No blocking findings. Guard script uses safe bash patterns (no eval/exec/source), auth guards preserved in both route handlers, restore fidelity confirmed (10/10 sampled files byte-identical to HEAD), no secrets in restored-files.txt, no @ts-ignore/as any regressions, tsc clean on modified files, fixtures are synthetic and safe. FR-3 guard exits 0 on production scope (2237 files, 663 tags, 0 violations) and correctly detects 1 violation per malformed fixture.

nonblocking_findings.description: Guard prints matched JSDoc comment lines (e.g., `@returns {string {} The result string`) in violation output. This is limited to JSDoc tag lines containing @param/@returns — documentation text, not secrets. Acceptable for a CI/lint tool.

Guard script line 60 uses unquoted `for raw in ${BALANCED_BRACES_SCOPE}`. The variable is sourced from script defaults or CI env, not end-user input. Acceptable for this CI context but would benefit from arrays for robustness.

Line 35 of restored-files.txt references `packages/core-auth/src/password-policy.ts`. This is a source file implementing password policy logic (not a secret file). Confirmed safe — the file contains exportable policy logic, not credentials.

evidence.detail: No eval/exec/source. Uses set -uo pipefail. find with -print0 + read -r -d '' for safe filename handling. Scope paths anchored to REPO_ROOT. awk program hardcoded with no variable interpolation.
GET and POST both gate on requireDeveloperRequestClaims(). Zod validation on inputs. Auth check survived JSDoc edit — @returns was the only change.
POST gates on getRequestSessionClaims() → 401. Role check student → 403. Enrollment check. Rate limiting. Prompt injection detection. All guards intact.
CourseOverviewGrid.tsx, StrugglingStudentsPanel.tsx, review-queue/index.tsx are client components — no server auth boundary. activity-map.ts is pure computation.

10 files sampled from restored-files.txt: all git diff HEAD -- <path> = empty. Files: session.ts, password-policy.ts, StepByStepper.tsx, MathBlock.tsx, generators.ts, edge-calibration.ts, injection.ts, admin.ts, gradebook.ts, placement-engine.ts.
Guard prints filename + violation type + matched JSDoc comment line. Output limited to @param/@returns documentation text — no source code body, no secrets.
All 4 fixtures are synthetic .ts files with intentionally malformed JSDoc tags. No real-world data, URLs, credentials, or injection vectors.
Only match is password-policy.ts (a source file, not a secret file). No .env files. No files with secret/key/token/credential in path.
npx tsc --noEmit on the 6 modified files: 0 new errors vs baseline. No @ts-ignore or as any added in JSDoc fixes.
